context.healthy_metrics_and_strengths_not_to_bre: Base hourly pay for sales associates is actually 10% above the regional retail average (exit interviews almost never cite base pay), employees love the 40% staff product discount, and our Turin HQ design/merchandising teams maintain 92% annual retention.
context.cohort_and_site_asymmetries: HQ and our 12 city-center flagship stores hire smoothly and keep staff long-term. The real bleeding is concentrated in the 78 suburban mall stores, where 24% of newly hired sales associates quit within their first 6 months due to chaotic weekend rosters and newly promoted store managers with zero people-management training.
context.budget_and_capacity_constraints: Store turnover and emergency weekend temp coverage are costing us an estimated €420k/year in replacement and lost-sales drag. The CFO has put a freeze on extra job-board ad spend until HR can show hard numbers on turnover risk and conversion ROI instead of social media likes.
context.leadership_perceptions_and_requests: The VP of Retail wants to immediately launch an Employee Ambassador campaign on Instagram and TikTok next month asking mall store staff to film 'Day in the Life' videos to fix our applicant shortage. At the same time, the Head of Marketing suggested a weekly B2B LinkedIn thought-leadership blog series to attract store associates, and Finance asked if we should cut the 40% staff discount to fund recruiting ads.
